ios.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Jibli uses your location only while you are using the app: to place your delivery point on the map when you save an address, and to pin your shop's location if you own a shop. Your location is never tracked in the background, and you can always type the address instead.
ios.NSCameraUsageDescription: Jibli uses the camera to photograph your products and your shop.
ios.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Jibli uses your photos to add product pictures and your shop's picture.
